DriveFile.title: DriveFile
DriveFile.description: Represents a physical file synced or uploaded in the HemoTrack Secure Drive Vault.

id.description: Unique identifier of the drive file

mimeType.description: Mime type format of the file

size.description: Integer size of the file in bytes

webViewLink.description: External view URL to the Google Drive asset

source.description: Specifies whether this is a simulated sandbox element or real file

userId.description: The Firebase User UID who owns this file

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: HIPAA compliance audit trace for security events and logs.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit event

action.description: Standardized action key (e.g. CREATE, DELETE, SYNC)

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the security log entry

userId.description: UID of the actor who performed the action

details.description: Optional verbose metadata for security audit trace

Volunteer.title: Volunteer
Volunteer.description: A registered volunteer for blood logistics, donation, or support coordination.

registeredAt.description: ISO timestamp representing volunteer registration time

userId.description: The Firebase User UID who created this volunteer registration, if authenticated

/driveFiles/{fileId}.description: Collection of documents representing all blood vault and cold chain files.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Compliance security log trail for verification.

/volunteers/{volunteerId}.description: Collection of documents representing all blood logistics volunteers.
